module_summary: AXI-lite crossbar address decoder: a 2-state FSM compares the incoming address against per-master base/width regions, registers the selected master index or a decode error, and issues address, write-command and reply-command valids before acknowledging the slave.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DECODE controller: decodes address then waits for all outputs accepted

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address region match flag choosing successful decode versus decode error

anchors.name: m_select_reg
anchors.why: Decoded master index driving m_select, m_wc_select and m_rc_select

anchors.name: m_decerr_reg
anchors.why: Decode error flag reported on write and reply command outputs

anchors.name: s_axil_aaddr
anchors.why: Incoming address compared against master regions

anchors.name: s_axil_aprot
anchors.why: Protection bits blocking access to secure masters

anchors.name: s_axil_avalid
anchors.why: Address valid starting decode in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axil_aready
anchors.why: Address accept pulse once all command outputs complete

anchors.name: m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid, enabled by WC_OUTPUT

anchors.name: m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Reply command valid carrying select and decerr

groups.name: Decode controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing decode and completion of address/command handshakes

groups.name: Address decoder
groups.description: Region match logic producing master select and decode error

groups.name: Command outputs
groups.description: Address, write-command and reply-command output handshakes
